dish: Chicken with garlic cream sauce and sesame crumb

blocks.title: Creamy garlic emulsion

steps.text: Simmer stock, cream and garlic 12 min.
Whisk in the butter cube by cube off the heat.

method_text: Simmer stock, cream and garlic 12 min.

forks.text: Creamy garlic emulsion: cold butter into hot liquid, or a cooked butter base started separately? The two give different sauces and the page does not say which one you make.

blocks.title: Sesame crumb

steps.text: Toast panko and sesame in the oil until dry and golden.
Cool on a tray before the tins.

method_text: Toast panko and sesame in the oil until dry and golden.
